description: StatsD receiver for ingesting StatsD messages(https://github.com/statsd/statsd/blob/master/docs/metric_types.md) into the OpenTelemetry Collector. Note: This receiver does not support horizontally scaled collector deployments. It is intended to run in agent mode, where a single collector instance receives StatsD input.

feature_gates.description: When enabled, changes the default value of is_monotonic_counter to true, so that statsd counters are treated as monotonic sums by default. Explicitly setting is_monotonic_counter in the receiver config always takes precedence over this feature gate.

name: statsdreceiver
